title: docs.apify.com/integrations/integrate.md
snippet:
### Authentication methods
Apify supports two main authentication methods for secure API access.
*OAuth 2.0* - Use OAuth 2.0 to allow users to authorize your integration without sharing their credentials.
*API token* - Apify user generates personal API token from Apify account settings page. For more information, see [API Token documentation](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/api#api-token).

Choose between two pricing models based on your integration setup.
#### Direct user billing
Users create their own Apify accounts and are billed directly by Apify for their usage. This model gives users full control over their Apify usage and billing.
#### Whitelabel access
Users access Apify through your platform without needing an Apify account. Apify bills you based on consumption, and you factor costs into your pricing.

Users pay a recurring fee — monthly or annually — for consistent API access. Available pricing plans are structured in tiers, each offering different limits, features, or performance levels. This model provides predictable revenue for providers and predictable costs for customers.

title: Apify pricing - flexible plan + pay as you go · Apify
snippet: Yes. An autonomous agent with a crypto wallet can pay through the agentic payment protocols [x402](https://www.x402.org/) and [MPP](https://mpp.dev/), with no account and no human sign-up. The agent pays once at [agi.apify.com](https://agi.apify.com/), receives a temporary Apify API token with a fixed spend cap, and calls the Apify API with it like any other token. Each Actor run is metered against that prepaid balance, and unused balance expires with the token.

title: apify.com/llms.txt
snippet:
An autonomous agent with a wallet and nobody to sign in buys a prepaid, spend-capped token at https://agi.apify.com through x402 or MPP.

- Creating an account is free and requires no credit card: the free plan renews $5 of usage credit every month, and if that credit runs out, access pauses until the next month instead of being billed. There is nothing to cancel.
- If a request fails because nobody is signed in, including a 402 that offers x402 payment, tell the user how to fix it instead of stopping: connect https://mcp.apify.com and sign in through the browser first; otherwise create a token at https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations and set it as an environment variable rather than pasting it into chat.
